A LITTLE MATH. A LOT OF POSSIBILITY.

Let’s play Krypto!

  1. Deal five number cards and a sixth target card.
  2. Use each of the five cards exactly once with addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division to reach the target.
  3. Found a solution? Hit Krypto!, enter or choose your name to unlock the cards, and tap cards and operations to build it.
  4. Press = to make a result card. Use that card in your next step: it’s a friendly way to group calculations.
  5. Reach the target using all five cards for an automatic point and a celebration! Hit Krypto again to try a different answer. Reordering or regrouping addition or multiplication counts as the same answer.

Whole-number mode requires nonnegative integers at every operation. Turn it off for exact fractions and negative numbers, starting on the next deal.

Our table rules: one point per different solution, shared across players for the round. No timer or penalties. Redeal keeps your players and scores; New game clears both after confirmation. Scores are saved in this browser.

Krypto King: Scott Huskey’s KryptoSolver algorithm searches in a background worker as soon as cards are dealt. A light bulb means a solution is ready: press Krypto King to reveal it and award one point. An X means no solution was found, so redeal. Searching never awards points on its own. It plays by the current round’s number rules and scores at most once per round. Redeal starts a new search. This is a local algorithm; it does not call an AI service.

Usage statistics: We count deck visits, hands shown, button presses, solutions scored, and the number of human players, using Plausible. Your player names and calculations stay in this browser and are not sent in analytics.

The 56-card deck has three each of 1–6, four each of 7–10, two each of 11–17, and one each of 18–25. The Primary age deck has five each of 1–10 (50 cards). Every redeal shuffles the entire selected deck and deals six cards without replacement. Switching decks redeals and keeps everyone’s scores. Some deals may have no solution.
